title: Visual Search
subtitle: Upload a face photo to run 1:N cosine similarity matching against enrolled gallery templates
disclaimer: Candidates are ranked by similarity and do not constitute identity confirmation; manual inspection is required.

dropzone.title: Upload Face Photo
dropzone.prompt: Drag & drop an image here, or click to select
dropzone.formatHint: Supports static JPG, PNG, and WebP (up to 10MB, max 4096px). Please upload a photo with a single clear face.
dropzone.unsupportedFormat: Unsupported file format. Please upload JPG, PNG, or WebP

controls.thresholdHint: Candidates below this score are filtered out (default 70%)

results.title: Search Results
results.idleDescription: Upload a face photo and click 'Search Gallery' to discover matching gallery personnel.
results.emptyDescription: No enrolled face templates reached the similarity threshold. Try lowering the threshold or uploading a clearer frontal face.
results.errorDescription: Image search encountered an error. Please verify network connectivity and retry.
results.workflowStep1Desc: Upload capture crops or ID portraits; clearer photos ensure higher matching accuracy
results.workflowStep2Desc: Extract 512-d embeddings and run instant cosine similarity search
results.workflowStep3Desc: Jump straight into historical captures and cross-camera trajectory
results.tipsItem1: Use frontal face photos with level gaze, even lighting, and high resolution
results.tipsItem2: Avoid heavy occlusions such as dark sunglasses, face masks, or wide-brimmed hats
results.tipsItem3: Embeddings are extracted in 512-d cosine vector space, resilient to lighting and subtle micro-expressions

compareDialog.title: Face Verification & Inspection
compareDialog.description: 1:1 side-by-side comparison between query photo and enrolled template
compareDialog.verdictHigh: High Match: Facial landmark features match enrolled template with very high confidence.
compareDialog.verdictMedium: Moderate Similarity: Core facial contours are close; inspect eyes, nose, and jawline features.
compareDialog.verdictLow: Borderline Candidate: Relative low confidence; verify cross-camera passes and timeline captures.
